meta_description: Who Arden Roofing is, the roofing replacement & repair services we provide, and the Asheville, NC communities we serve.
intro_html: Arden Roofing is a locally focused residential roofing company built around a simple idea: homeowners deserve a clear explanation of what their roof needs before they are asked to make a major decision.
body_html:
Our Story

Owner Caleb Whitaker grew up south of Asheville and spent much of his early working life around residential construction. He entered roofing through a local crew, first handling tear-offs and material staging before learning repair work, flashing, layout, project planning, and eventually crew leadership. Years on roofs throughout Buncombe and Henderson counties gave him an appreciation for how different Western North Carolina homes can be, even when they are only a few miles apart.

Caleb started Arden Roofing after seeing the same homeowner frustration again and again: people often knew something was wrong with their roof but did not know whether the answer was a small repair or a major replacement. He wanted the company to begin with diagnosis and explanation instead of a sales pitch. Arden became the natural home base because it was close to where he grew up and centrally located for work throughout south Asheville and the surrounding mountain communities.

Today, Arden Roofing focuses on residential roof repair, installation, and replacement. Caleb still stays close to field work and project planning, while Mason Greene helps coordinate roofing crews and Emily Brooks keeps customers informed about scheduling and project details. The company has grown, but its view of the trade remains the same: good roofing is careful construction work, and homeowners should understand what is being done to their house and why.

What We Do

We focus on Roofing Repair, Roofing Install, and Roofing Replacement. Each service has its own page so you can see exactly what is involved before you call.

  • Roofing Repair
  • Roofing Install
  • Roofing Replacement

Where We Work

We are based around Arden, NC and serve Asheville, NC, including Arden, Asheville, Hendersonville, Fairview, Fletcher, Biltmore, Biltmore Village, West Asheville, South Asheville, Downtown Asheville, North Asheville, East Asheville, Black Mountain, Oakley, Hawk Creek, Mills River, Kenilworth, Beaverdam, Reynolds, Bent Creek, Avery Creek, Biltmore Forest, Candler, Enka, Leicester, Montreat, Skyland, Swannanoa, Weaverville, Woodfin, Alexander, Barnardsville, Marshall, Mars Hill, and Canton.

How We Work

Explain before recommending

Roofing can be difficult to evaluate from the ground. We believe homeowners should hear what we observed and how it connects to the work being proposed.

Match the work to the problem

A repair should stay a repair when that is the sensible answer. A replacement should be recommended because the condition supports it, not because it is the largest project available.

Respect the whole property

The roof may be our work area, but the driveway, landscaping, entrances, neighboring property, and cleanup all matter to the homeowner.

Do the details that disappear

Many important roofing components are hidden once the project is complete. We treat preparation, underlayment, flashing, transitions, and fastening as essential parts of the finished job.

The People Behind Arden Roofing

Meet the people who answer the phone and do the work on our Meet the Team page, or see how to join us on our Careers page.

meta_description: Join Arden Roofing. Technician, crew lead, estimator, and office roles in Asheville, NC.
intro_html: Arden Roofing looks for dependable people who take pride in physical work, communicate well with a crew, and understand that good roofing depends on details that customers may never see.
body_html:
What We Look For

  • Care about the work. We want people who take pride in doing roofing replacement & repair properly, not just quickly.
  • Straight talk with customers. You will be in someone's home or business explaining what you found. Plain language beats jargon.
  • Reliability. Showing up when you said you would matters more here than any single line on a resume.
  • Respect for the property. Protecting the space, cleaning up, and leaving it better than you found it.
  • Safety, every time. Following safe practice is part of the job, not an extra.

Experience in roofing replacement & repair or a related trade helps. If you have the attitude and not yet the trade experience, say so, because we do train.

Roles We Hire For

We are a small team, so openings come and go with the work. These are the roles we hire into.

Roofing Installer

Work with the field crew on residential roof installation and replacement projects, including tear-off, material handling, underlayment, shingle installation, flashing support, and jobsite cleanup.

Qualifications

  • Comfortable with outdoor physical work and changing weather conditions
  • Able to follow jobsite safety procedures and crew direction
  • Dependable transportation and consistent attendance
  • Roofing or construction experience is helpful but not required for every opening

Benefits

  • On-the-job skill development
  • Consistent local and regional project work
  • Opportunities to take on additional crew responsibility
  • Team environment focused on organized, careful work

Roof Repair Technician

Inspect and complete residential repair work involving shingles, flashing, roof penetrations, valleys, transitions, and other localized roofing problems.

Qualifications

  • Previous roofing or exterior construction experience
  • Comfort working on residential roofs of varying pitches
  • Ability to think through likely water-entry paths
  • Clear communication with project leads and homeowners

Benefits

  • Varied repair work rather than repetitive production only
  • Opportunity to build advanced diagnostic skills
  • Local service-area projects
  • Room to grow into field leadership

Roofing Project Lead

Help organize residential roofing projects from material staging through completion, coordinate the crew, watch key installation details, and communicate field conditions that affect the planned scope.

Qualifications

  • Strong residential roofing experience
  • Ability to lead a small crew and keep work organized
  • Working knowledge of shingles, underlayment, flashing, and roof transitions
  • Good judgment around jobsite safety, weather, access, and property protection

Benefits

  • Leadership responsibility on local projects
  • Opportunity to help train developing installers
  • Direct communication with company ownership
  • Varied work across the Asheville region

Customer & Project Coordinator

Support customer communication, estimate follow-up, scheduling, project notes, and coordination between homeowners and the field team.

Qualifications

  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Comfort managing schedules and detailed project notes
  • Reliable follow-through
  • Experience in home services, construction, or customer support is helpful

Benefits

  • Work closely with a small local team
  • Learn the residential roofing process
  • Meaningful role in keeping customers informed
  • Opportunities to take on broader operations responsibilities

How to Apply

Email sales@ardenroofing.com with "Careers" and the role in the subject line. Include:

  • A short note about the kind of work you have done
  • Your resume, or simply a list of previous jobs and dates
  • The area you can reliably get to
  • A phone number and the best time to reach you

We read every application. If there is a fit, expect a short phone conversation first, then a meeting and a ride-along on a job so you can see the work before you commit to it.

We do not always have an opening posted. Send your information anyway. We keep applications on file and reach out first to people who already introduced themselves when a spot opens.

Arden Roofing considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Questions about this page?

Prefer to talk? Call (828) 305-4838 or email sales@ardenroofing.com and we will get back to you.

meta_description: How Arden Roofing collects, uses, and protects your information when you use this site or contact us.
intro_html: This policy explains what information Arden Roofing collects when you use this site or contact us about roofing replacement & repair, how that information is used, and the choices you have.
body_html:
Information We Collect

Information you give us

When you submit a form, call, or email us, we collect what you choose to share. That usually includes:

  • Your name, phone number, and email address
  • The address or general location of the property
  • A description of the roofing replacement & repair work you are asking about
  • Any photos, documents, or notes you send us

Information collected automatically

Like most websites, this site records basic technical details when you visit: IP address, browser and device type, pages viewed, time on the page, and the site or search that sent you here. This comes from cookies and similar technologies.

Call and form tracking

We may use a third party call and form tracking service to understand which pages and marketing sources produce inquiries. When you call a number listed on this site, that service may record the number you dialed, your phone number, the date and time, the length of the call, and the marketing source connected to your visit. If a call is recorded, you will be told at the start of the call.

How We Use Your Information

  • To respond to your question and schedule a visit
  • To prepare an estimate and explain your options
  • To follow up about scheduling, work in progress, or a project you asked about
  • To keep records of the work we perform
  • To measure which pages and marketing sources bring in inquiries
  • To improve the content and usability of this site
  • To meet legal, tax, insurance, and safety obligations

We contact you using the phone number or email address you provide. Consent to receive calls or texts is not a condition of any purchase, and you can ask us to stop contacting you at any time.

How We Share Information

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only in these situations:

  • People doing the work. Team members and independent contractors involved in inspecting, quoting, or completing your project.
  • Service providers. Companies that run our website hosting, form handling, call tracking, email, and analytics, and that may only use the information to provide those services.
  • Legal reasons. When we are required to share information by law, or when it is needed to protect our rights, our team, or the safety of others.
  • Business transfer. If the business is sold or reorganized, customer records may transfer with it.

See our Referral Marketing Disclosure for how inquiries may be passed to contractors we work with.

Cookies, Analytics, and Your Choices

Cookies let the site remember your visit and let us measure traffic. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. If you do, parts of the site may not work the way they should, but you can still reach us by phone or email.

Email and text messages

We send email about the project or question you contacted us about. If we ever send marketing email, every message includes an unsubscribe link, and unsubscribing stops those messages. Reply STOP to any text message to stop texts.

Access, correction, and deletion

You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. We will do so unless we need to keep a record for legal, tax, or warranty reasons, and we will tell you if that is the case.

Children

This site is intended for adults arranging roofing replacement & repair. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16.

Security and Retention

We take reasonable steps to protect the information you share, including using trusted service providers and limiting who can see customer records. No website or email system is completely secure, so please do not send sensitive financial information through the form.

We keep inquiry and project records for as long as they are useful for serving you and for as long as the law requires, then delete or anonymize them.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of the page shows the current version.

Questions about this page?

Call (828) 305-4838 or email sales@ardenroofing.com and we will get back to you.

body_html:
Using This Site

The pages here describe roofing replacement & repair and related services in Asheville, NC. They are general information about our services. Nothing on this site is an offer, a contract, or a promise to perform work at a particular price.

Please use the site for its intended purpose. Do not attempt to disrupt it, copy it wholesale, scrape it, or submit false information through the form.

Estimates and pricing

Any prices or cost ranges shown on this site are planning figures based on typical projects. They are not quotes. Actual pricing depends on what we find during a site visit: access, condition, materials, permits, and the scope you approve. The written estimate you sign is what governs the work, and it replaces anything stated on this site.

No professional advice

Content on this site is not engineering, legal, insurance, or other professional advice. Every property is different and has to be seen in person. If a specialist is needed for your situation, we will tell you.

Your Responsibilities

  • Give accurate contact and property information when you request an estimate
  • Have the authority of the property owner to request a visit or work

  • Tell us about known hazards, prior repairs, or pending insurance claims

Contact permission

By submitting the form or calling, you agree that we may contact you at the number and email you provide about your request. Consent is not a condition of purchasing anything, and you can opt out at any time.

Content, Links, and Liability

Intellectual property

The text, layout, and images on this site belong to Arden Roofing or are used with permission. You may share a link or print a page for your own use. Republishing the content elsewhere without written permission is not permitted.

Links to other sites

Where we link to another website, we do so because it may be useful. We do not control those sites and are not responsible for their content or their privacy practices.

Site availability and accuracy

We work to keep the site accurate and available, but we provide it "as is." Prices, service details, and coverage areas change. We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the site, and nothing here limits your rights under applicable consumer protection law or any warranty in a signed agreement with us.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of North Carolina.

Changes

We may update these terms. The date at the top of the page shows the current version.

Questions about this page?

Ask us before you assume anything on this page applies to your project. Call (828) 305-4838 or email sales@ardenroofing.com and we will get back to you.

meta_description: General information disclaimer for Arden Roofing, covering cost ranges, photos, results, and outside sources.
intro_html: The information on this site is meant to help people understand roofing replacement & repair and how it is done. It is general information, not an assessment of your property or project.
body_html:
What This Site Can and Cannot Tell You

No two properties are the same. Age, condition, prior work, access, and what you want the result to be all change what the right approach is. Two jobs that look alike from the outside can need completely different work.

Nothing on this site should be treated as a diagnosis, a professional opinion, or a recommendation for your specific property. An in-person visit is the only way to identify what is needed and the right way to do it.

Cost ranges

Any prices or ranges shown on our service pages are planning figures for typical projects in Asheville, NC. They are not quotes and they are not a price guarantee. Costs move with access, materials, permits, and scope.

Photos

Photographs on this site are illustrative. They show the kinds of conditions and work described in the text and are not presented as before and after documentation of a specific customer project.

Results, Warranties, and Outside Sources

No guaranteed outcome

Good work reduces problems and lasts, but weather, use, changes to the property, maintenance, and future work by others all affect how anything performs over time. Any warranty that applies to your project is the one written into your signed agreement.

Third party information

Links to other websites are provided for convenience. We do not control that content and are not responsible for its accuracy.

Errors and updates

We keep this site current, but details change and mistakes happen. If you find something that looks wrong or out of date, tell us and we will correct it.

Emergencies

If you are facing a situation that threatens safety or is causing active damage, do not wait for a website. Call emergency services if anyone is at risk, then call us at (828) 305-4838.

Questions about this page?

If something here is unclear, ask before you make a decision about your project. Call (828) 305-4838 or email sales@ardenroofing.com and we will get back to you.

meta_description: Our accessibility commitment, the WCAG 2.1 AA standard we work toward, known limitations, and how to get help another way.
intro_html: We want everyone to be able to read this site, understand what we do, and reach us. That includes people using screen readers, keyboard navigation, magnification, or captions.
body_html:
What We Aim For

We use the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 level AA as our reference standard. That is the benchmark most organizations work toward, and it is what we check new pages against.

Steps we have taken

  • Headings are structured in order so screen readers can move through a page
  • Navigation, links, buttons, and the estimate form can be operated with a keyboard
  • Images carry text alternatives that describe what they show
  • Text and background colors are chosen for readable contrast, including on buttons
  • Text reflows and stays readable when you zoom or use a phone
  • Form fields have visible labels rather than placeholder text alone

Known Limitations

Some parts of the site rely on third party services, such as call tracking and form handling, and we do not control their code. Documents or maps we link to may not be fully accessible. When we find a barrier, we fix it or provide another way to get the same information.

If something does not work for you

Tell us what happened and we will help right away and fix the page. It helps if you can include:

  • The page address you were on
  • What you were trying to do
  • The device, browser, or assistive technology you were using

We aim to respond within three business days. If a page is blocking you, we will give you the same information by phone or email in the meantime, including answering estimate questions over the phone so you never have to use the form.

Getting Help Another Way

You never have to use this website to work with us. Call (828) 305-4838 and a person will talk through your question, schedule a visit, and read back anything you need from the site.

Questions about this page?

Accessibility feedback is welcome, and we act on it. Call (828) 305-4838 or email sales@ardenroofing.com and we will get back to you.

meta_description: How to raise a concern with Arden Roofing, what happens next, and the timelines we hold ourselves to.
intro_html: Our work happens at your property, and sometimes things do not go the way anyone planned. When that happens we want to hear it directly, early, and in your own words.
body_html:
How to Raise a Concern

Call (828) 305-4838 or email sales@ardenroofing.com. If it is easier to explain by phone, call and ask for the person who handled your project.

It helps if you can tell us:

  • Your name, the property address, and roughly when the work or visit happened
  • What was supposed to happen and what actually happened
  • Photos, if the issue is something you can see
  • What outcome you are looking for

You will not be penalized for complaining, and raising an issue does not affect any warranty in your agreement.

What Happens Next

  1. We acknowledge it within two business days. You will hear from a person, not an automated reply, confirming what we understood and who is handling it.
  2. We look into it. That can mean reviewing the estimate and job notes, talking with the crew, and in most cases coming back out to look at the work.
  3. We give you a written response within ten business days. It explains what we found, what we will do, and the timing. If the review needs longer, we tell you why and when to expect an answer.
  4. We follow through and check back. After corrective work, we confirm with you that the issue is actually resolved.

If You Are Still Not Satisfied

Ask for the complaint to be escalated to Caleb Whitaker, who will review the file personally and respond to you.

You always keep your outside options, including your state or local consumer protection office and any licensing board that covers roofing replacement & repair. Using this policy first is not a requirement, and it does not limit your rights.

What we do with complaints

We keep a record of what was raised and how it was resolved, and we review those records so the same problem does not repeat on the next project.

Questions about this page?

Tell us early. Small problems are much easier to fix than old ones. Call (828) 305-4838 or email sales@ardenroofing.com and we will get back to you.

meta_description: How the Arden Roofing website operates and how referrals to contractors are handled.
intro_html: We think you should know how this website operates and how the people who do your roofing replacement & repair work are paid. This page explains it in plain language.
body_html:
How This Site Works

ardenroofing.com is a marketing website for Arden Roofing. When you submit the estimate form or call a number on this site, your request comes to us.

Depending on the type of work, where the property is, and how the schedule looks, a project may be handled by our own team or referred to an independent, qualified contractor we work with in Asheville, NC. When a referral leads to work, we may receive compensation from that contractor.

We also use call tracking and analytics so we can tell which pages and advertising sources produce inquiries. That is measurement, not a change to what you are quoted.

What This Means for You

  • You will know who is coming. Ask who will perform the work and we will tell you before anyone is scheduled.
  • Your written estimate is the price. Whatever arrangement exists behind the scenes, the signed estimate is what you pay.
  • You are free to compare. Getting a second opinion on a roofing replacement & repair project is reasonable, and we will not push you away from doing it.
  • Independent contractors are independent. They carry their own licensing, insurance, and warranty terms. Ask to see them, and read the agreement you sign with them.

Advertising and third parties

This site may appear in paid search results or other advertising. Any third party service we use to run or measure that advertising receives only what it needs to do the job. Our Privacy Policy covers what is collected and shared.

Questions About a Referral

If you want to know who would handle your project, whether a referral is involved, or how to reach a contractor directly, just ask. We would rather answer the question up front than have you wonder about it later.

Questions about this page?

Ask us anything about how a project would be handled. Call (828) 305-4838 or email sales@ardenroofing.com and we will get back to you.
